purpose: The check-run names a pull request to main gets, derived from .github/workflows/*.yml by scripts/derive-pr-check-names.mjs, with the proposed role of each name in the branch ruleset. A proposal for ZURIEL: nothing here changes the ruleset. test/required-checks-definition-2029.test.mjs fails when a workflow gains, loses or renames a pull-request job, changes its trigger class or its timeout, or when a name proposed as required is path-filtered, duplicated or live-state dependent. Regenerate the derived fields with: node scripts/derive-pr-check-names.mjs --json

tiers.required-now: always triggered on pull requests to main, unique job name, independent of live state: can be named in the ruleset without any workflow change
tiers.rename-first: cannot be named before the job names are made unique
tiers.never-required-live-state: depends on live state; a decision for ZURIEL
tiers.aggregator-candidate: path-filtered, and guards something that matters; becomes enforceable only with the aggregator or complement-workflow change described in required-checks.md section 4
